        "All changed Thunderbird/shared hunks in 16 paths were read. The shared amUtils helper is bounded to its changed Thunderbird dispatch; the Suite-only branch is excluded.         "The actual foreground change is win.focus before finding, refreshing or opening the Account Settings tab in an existing main window. The selected-page/server setters and account-tree focus stay in the old callbacks; this is a focus request, not a native foreground success assertion.",
        "The patch removes openOptionsDialog, which already returned openPreferencesTab with the same arguments, and changes its menus, notifications, remote-content, compose and account-central callers to the retained function.         "The Calendar test helper becomes openSettingsTab so it does not shadow the production openPreferencesTab.         "The awaited Dock Options consumer still depends on the preferences opener promise. Exact current getter, preferences reuse branch and tabmail return path match the existing bounded unsettled-promise finding.
